summary: Nora knows which chat she is actually in. Asked on Discord, she no longer says she is on Signal.
details: She is told where she is on every turn, the same way she is told the time — both exist because a model with no situational model invents one and does not know it is inventing.
It also matters for anything addressed at another room: «send this to the others» means a different place depending on where she is standing.
limitations: She is told the platform's name only, never the room's internal id.
